Learning from battles, a Stats page, and a lighter exe. Replaces v1.0.

**Builder Base**
- The bot reads each battle's results screen (stars, total damage, gold and trophies won) and learns which way of picking the attack side wins: the best side, the one nearest the core, the one with the most buildings in reach, or the Multi Mortar's for a P.E.K.K.A push. Each battle's plan is drawn from what the plans did so far: the winners get played more, the others now and then. A P.E.K.K.A push starts with the Multi Mortar first and switches only to a plan that does clearly better. The Logs page shows each draw.
- Card health is read right again: from the first stage on, every troop read 100 % while under fire, so health-driven abilities only went at their deadline. The P.E.K.K.A's Overcharge (a blast around her; she lives on) now goes once the defences have her under 70 %, not before 6 s, by 30 s at the latest.
- Return Home is tapped once the results screen has settled, so the tap is no longer lost.

**Home Village**
- The loot filter takes a dark elixir minimum too (Run page or Settings).
- The log says whether the Earthquake spells were cast, or that none was in the bar.

**App**
- A **Stats** page: every session (battles, gold, elixir and dark elixir, per hour; stars and damage on the Builder Base), the damage of the last Builder Base battles, and an export of every battle to CSV. Battles are kept from this version on, on your machine only.
- A Windows notification when a run ends, or stops on an error.
- At launch, BasePilot checks GitHub for a newer release and links it in the status bar. It sends nothing about you; turn it off in Settings → App.
- The exe is about 135 MB instead of 218 MB: Tesseract was bundled twice, with tools the bot never runs.
- 16:9 windows have the second Return Home button art too.

16:9 windows are still checked on rebuilt screenshots only. If something goes wrong, send the log (Logs page) and the `debug` folder from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BasePilot`.

Download **BasePilot.exe** (Tesseract and the OCR model are bundled); **BasePilot.exe.sha256** has its checksum. The exe is not signed, so SmartScreen warns: More info, then Run anyway. Botting breaks Supercell's terms of service and can get an account banned.
